entries.title: Codec constraints conflict
entries.root_cause: The project requires sundial-codec>=3 but lichen-exporter 1.4.0 requires sundial-codec<3. The codec constraints must be made compatible.

entries.title: Codec constraints block lock
entries.root_cause: The project requires sundial-codec>=3 but lichen-exporter 1.4.0 requires sundial-codec<3. The codec constraints must be made compatible.
entries.differs_from_earlier: A later pull request uses another runner and checks the lock file.

entries.title: Transport constraints conflict
entries.root_cause: The project requires oriel-transport>=2 but moss-relay 2.1.0 requires oriel-transport<2. The transport constraints must be made compatible.
entries.differs_from_earlier: The resolver reports the same error family for different packages and incompatible transport constraints.

entries.title: Codec constraints block sync
entries.root_cause: The project requires sundial-codec>=3 but lichen-exporter 1.4.0 requires sundial-codec<3. The codec constraints must be made compatible.
entries.differs_from_earlier: A later sync creates a fresh environment before resolving the same conflict.
